title: Unique lift of a map to cartesian line presentations
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme, $X$ an algebraic space over $S$, and $P,Q$ etale line presentations [def-trf-cartesian-line-presentation]. Every morphism $f:P.\mathrm{line}\to Q.\mathrm{line}$ lifts to exactly one cartesian family morphism $e:P\to Q$ inducing $f$ on small-etale global sections.

source.place: Tags 03G7 and 03M3; descent.tex Tags 03DX, 03LC, 023T and 05VG. The atlas argument and its morphism argument are specialized to rank one.

proof.text: Two lifts have equal global-section maps on every small-etale test, because Q.etaleSections is injective. For each open U of such a test T, use the open test U to T. Cartesian naturality and invertibility of the comparison for Q show equality of the pulled-back maps on top sections. Naturality of the canonical tensor-to-open section isomorphism [new-etale-tensor-open-section-iso] then gives equality of the maps on sections over U. Sheaf morphism extensionality gives equality on T.

For any test W, base change the atlas in [def-trf-algebraic-space]. The resulting test B maps both to W by an etale surjective scheme morphism and to a small-etale test T. Equality on T and cartesian naturality give equality on B. Apply faithful fpqc descent of morphisms [lem-pc-fpqc-descent] to P_W and Q_W. Their quasi-coherence follows from invertibility. The tensor comparison to ordinary pullback transfers the equality to this descent functor. Hence the maps agree on W. Componentwise extensionality finishes.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03G7 and 03M3; descent.tex Tags 03DX, 03LC, 023T and 05VG. The atlas argument and its morphism argument are specialized to rank one.

theorem existsUnique_testLineHom {X : AlgebraicSpace S} (P Q : EtaleLinePresentation X)
    (f : P.line ⟶ Q.line) :
    ∃! e : TestLineHom P.toTestLineFamily Q.toTestLineFamily,
      e.IsEtaleCompatible P Q f
